import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mp
import numpy as np

# data computed in previous cells (hard-coded here for the figure; values are the computed ones)
bj=[("bll6430",7078565,7079542,"-","SphA family"),("blr6429",7077548,7078477,"+","LysR regulator"),
    ("bll6428",7076273,7077430,"-","alpha/beta hydrolase"),("bll6427",7075294,7076247,"-","VOC dioxygenase"),
    ("bll6426",7074942,7075310,"-","Rieske 2Fe-2S"),("bll6425",7073772,7074902,"-","FAD oxidoreductase"),
    ("bll6424",7072529,7073692,"-","MFS transporter"),("bll6423",7071925,7072503,"-","cupin"),
    ("bll6422",7070894,7071928,"-","FAH family"),("bll6421",7069951,7070889,"-","NAD epimerase/dehydratase")]
hs=[("fdeR/Hsero_1002",1109847,1110776,"-","LysR regulator"),("fdeA/Hsero_1003",1111119,1111982,"+","SphA family"),
    ("fdeB/Hsero_1004",1112013,1113173,"+","alpha/beta hydrolase"),("fdeC/Hsero_1005",1113202,1114128,"+","VOC dioxygenase"),
    ("fdeD/Hsero_1006",1114173,1114511,"+","Rieske 2Fe-2S"),("fdeE/Hsero_1007",1114544,1115674,"+","FAD monooxygenase"),
    ("fdeF/Hsero_1008",1115752,1116906,"+","MFS transporter"),("fdeG/Hsero_1009",1116903,1117718,"+","cyclase"),
    ("fdeH/Hsero_1010",1117742,1118332,"+","cupin"),("fdeI/Hsero_1011",1118336,1119319,"+","FAH family"),
    ("fdeJ/Hsero_1012",1119316,1120278,"+","NAD epimerase/dehydratase")]
pid={"bll6430":45.9,"blr6429":48.0,"bll6428":81.2,"bll6427":59.4,"bll6426":49.0,"bll6425":54.0,
     "bll6424":56.6,"bll6423":67.0,"bll6422":61.7,"bll6421":48.9}
partner={"bll6430":"fdeA/Hsero_1003","blr6429":"fdeR/Hsero_1002","bll6428":"fdeB/Hsero_1004","bll6427":"fdeC/Hsero_1005",
         "bll6426":"fdeD/Hsero_1006","bll6425":"fdeE/Hsero_1007","bll6424":"fdeF/Hsero_1008","bll6423":"fdeH/Hsero_1010",
         "bll6422":"fdeI/Hsero_1011","bll6421":"fdeJ/Hsero_1012"}

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(14,5.6))
def draw(genes, y, x0, flip, colmap):
    pos={}
    for name,s,e,st,fun in genes:
        a=(s-x0)/1000.0; b=(e-x0)/1000.0
        if flip: a,b=-b,-a
        d = 1 if (st=="+")!=flip else -1
        if flip: d=-d
        col=colmap(name,fun)
        if d>0: pts=[(a,y-.18),(b-.12,y-.18),(b,y),(b-.12,y+.18),(a,y+.18)]
        else:   pts=[(b,y-.18),(a+.12,y-.18),(a,y),(a+.12,y+.18),(b,y+.18)]
        ax.add_patch(mp.Polygon(pts, closed=True, fc=col, ec="black", lw=.6))
        pos[name]=((a+b)/2, y)
    return pos
def cb(name,fun):
    if "FAH" in fun: return "#c1442e"
    if "LysR" in fun: return "#9aa5b1"
    if "cyclase" in fun: return "#e8b63c"
    return "#6f9ac8"
# B. diazoefficiens: minus-strand operon, flip so transcription reads left to right
p1=draw(bj, 1.0, 7069951, True, cb)
p2=draw(hs, 0.0, 1109847, False, cb)
for g,q in partner.items():
    x1,y1=p1[g]; x2,y2=p2[q]
    ax.plot([x1,x2],[y1-0.2,y2+0.2], color="#b0b8c4", lw=1.0, zorder=0)
    ax.text((x1+x2)/2,(y1+y2)/2, f"{pid[g]:.0f}%", fontsize=7.5, ha="center", va="center",
            bbox=dict(fc="white", ec="none", pad=0.6))
for name,s,e,st,fun in bj:
    x,y=p1[name]; ax.text(x, y+0.33, name, fontsize=8, rotation=20, ha="center")
    ax.text(x, y+0.62, fun, fontsize=6.6, rotation=20, ha="center", color="#555")
for name,s,e,st,fun in hs:
    x,y=p2[name]; ax.text(x, y-0.40, name.split("/")[0], fontsize=8, rotation=-20, ha="center")
    ax.text(x, y-0.70, fun, fontsize=6.6, rotation=-20, ha="center", color="#555")
ax.text(-10.6,1.0,"B. diazoefficiens\nUSDA110", fontsize=9, ha="right", va="center", fontweight="bold")
ax.text(-0.6,0.0,"H. seropedicae\nSmR1 fde operon", fontsize=9, ha="right", va="center", fontweight="bold")
ax.annotate("", xy=(-1.2,0.0), xytext=(-9.8,0.0), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", color="none"))
ax.set_xlim(-12.5, 11.5); ax.set_ylim(-1.5, 2.1)
ax.set_xlabel("kb (B. diazoefficiens locus drawn reverse-complemented so both operons read left to right)")
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.spines[["top","right","left"]].set_visible(False)
ax.set_title("bll6422 lies in a gene-for-gene syntenic copy of the naringenin fde operon; only the fdeG cyclase is absent from the locus")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
